front.label: Front
front.desc: Your name, your number out of 25 and the two brands. The Hyperliquid shape is filled with your namehash.

front.label: Name
front.desc: Your .hl or .eth name. The ending is filled in mint.

front.label: Brands
front.desc: Hyperliquid India and ENS, the two parties behind the card.

front.label: Namehash fill
front.desc: The Hyperliquid shape is filled with your namehash, so no two cards carry the same text.

front.label: Signed message
front.desc: The message across the waist ties the name, the card number and the HYPE token together.

back.label: Back
back.desc: The HYPE genesis record, the token, and the holder this card was made for.

back.label: Genesis record
back.desc: Date, unix time, token address, supply, distribution and wallets of the HYPE genesis.

back.label: Holder
back.desc: Your name and the namehash of the name this card belongs to.

back.label: QR
back.desc: Scan or tap to open the card page and verify the holder onchain.
